integrity: The argument is symbolic. Sharpness is verified by an explicit associative three-step-zero multiplication and exact opposite iterated ultralimits of a triangular sign matrix; no finite computation is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The invariant is defined relative to a fixed Banach-space norm and does not classify extreme or strong Arens irregularity.
The universal distance estimate is a lower bound; equality is proved for the explicit nilpotent sharpness example, not for every algebra.
title: The Arens-product gap is sharply 2-Lipschitz under multiplication perturbations
